name: snes
description: A Super Nintendo on a brick screen: /snes load <link>, /snes here, then play with the controller pedestal (interact) or /snes <button>.
author: pooper

width.description: Screen width in pixels (64, 128 or 256 = 1:1; height is 7/8 of it)

pixel-size.description: Screen pixel size in units (2 = one micro brick)

fps.description: Screen updates per second (the game itself runs at 60)

press-ms.description: How long one controller press or /snes <button> holds the button

merge-tolerance.description: Neighbouring pixels within this colour difference merge into one brick

bricks-per-second.description: Most bricks per second sent to the server

sound.description: Play the game's music/sound on synth speakers on the pedestal (pitch tracking)

voices.description: Speakers (strongest pitches played at once, max 6)

audio-hz.description: Sound updates per second (each note change swaps a speaker brick)

synth.description: Speaker sound: sine, square, saw or triangle

synth-base-hz.description: Pitch of the synth at pitch 1.0

commands.name: /snes
commands.description: load <link|rom>, here [-x|+x|-y|+y] [64|128|256], <buttons> [seconds], hold <button>, release, sound on|off [synth], reset, pause, roms, stats, redraw, off
